author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Loyalty Data Audit
challenge.description: A legal audit flagged that loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, breaking the legal basis for using it in forecasts. #requirements_reuben# demands the data contracts be fully automated and governed to enforce consent checks before any data enters the pipeline. #efficiency_emilia# argues that manual review is sufficient for now to avoid delaying the promotion planning cycle, though she might accept a middle ground if it does not stall the weekly leaflet.

output.content: I am prepared to leave the KPI definitions exactly as they are, reviewed by hand. That is my concession. In exchange, the data contracts must be fully automated and governed so that consent checks are enforced before any loyalty basket data enters the pipeline. If the audit lands first and we have a strict, automated gate on that personal data, I will not push for changes to how you review your metrics. I am accepting the status quo on the KPIs because the automated consent enforcement is the higher priority for legal compliance. The trade is clear: you keep your manual review process for the KPIs, and I get a fully automated, governed data contract that verifies consent before any scan lines touch the forecast models.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly concedes to keeping the manual KPI review process in exchange for automated data contracts, stating they are willing to give up the push for KPI changes to secure compliance.
